color.note: Dark is the primary theme (gym, evening runs, OLED). Light is for daytime and web. Every text/background pair named in the usage notes is checked: ≥4.5:1 for text, ≥3:1 for control borders, zones and focus, in both themes.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App screen background. Base for every surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and panels on top of `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surface: modals, menus, nested cards on `surface` (in light theme separated by `line` + `shadow-md`).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: progress tracks, input fields, chart backgrounds.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders (decorative, no contrast requirement).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips) — ≥3:1 on `surface` and `bg`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metric labels, meta info on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, inactive icons, hints on `surface` and `bg`. ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Brand. Fill for the primary action (one per screen), active state, completion progress. Text on it is `on-volt`.

tokens.name: volt-mark
tokens.usage: Brand as meaningful graphics: progress ring and completion bar fill, active tab-bar indicator. ≥3:1 on `surface`, `bg`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `volt` fill.

tokens.name: volt-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet brand background: selected chip, completed-day highlight. Text on it is `volt-ink`.

tokens.name: volt-ink
tokens.usage: Brand as text/icon: links, accent numbers on `surface`, `bg`, `volt-soft`.

tokens.name: coach
tokens.usage: The AI coach's voice: avatar, “Coach” label, recommendation border, “Why?” link. As text — on `surface`, `bg`, `coach-soft`.

tokens.name: coach-soft
tokens.usage: Background of AI coach messages and recommendation cards.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: “Done” status, positive delta. Always paired with a word or icon. Text on `surface`, `bg`, `success-soft`.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge/banner background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: “Partial” status, overload risk. Text on `surface`, `bg`, `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge/banner background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missed workout, error, destructive action. Text on `surface`, `bg`, `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge/banner background.

tokens.name: zone-1
tokens.usage: Zone 1 — recovery. Fill for zone bars/charts; ≥3:1 on `surface`. Always labelled Z1.

tokens.name: zone-2
tokens.usage: Zone 2 — aerobic base. ≥3:1 on `surface`. Labelled Z2.

tokens.name: zone-3
tokens.usage: Zone 3 — tempo. ≥3:1 on `surface`. Labelled Z3.

tokens.name: zone-4
tokens.usage: Zone 4 — threshold. ≥3:1 on `surface`. Labelled Z4.

tokens.name: zone-5
tokens.usage: Zone 5 — VO2max / anaerobic. ≥3:1 on `surface`. Labelled Z5.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer under modals and bottom sheets.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero number of a screen: weekly distance, race result. One per screen.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Value in a MetricTile: heart rate, pace, load. Units beside it in `label`.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: You've recovered well — today we can add one more interval.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 15 min warm-up in Z2, then the main set.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, field labels, units.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta info: sync time, axis labels.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tabular numbers: split paces, heart rate, interval times.

styles.name: data-s
styles.usage: Small numbers on charts and zones.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Mobile screen: `space-4` margins, cards `space-6` apart.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and text, number and unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge inner padding, gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a card, horizontal chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile card padding, screen side margins.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal button padding, large card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a feed.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top offset of a hero screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large gaps on web.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Zone segments, tags in charts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, MetricTile, list items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Workout cards, coach messages, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, tab-bar indicator, coach avatar, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and tiles sitting on `bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating elements: tab bar, toast, record button.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets above `scrim`.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: buttons, chips (via padding), tabs.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of large buttons and inputs — usable with gloves / mid-run.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in badges and data.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and lists.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab-bar and header icons.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab-bar height without safe area.
